<!-- Generated by genconfdocs from the config structs in server/config. Do not edit. -->

The schema is parsed but not yet consumed by the server: setting these has no effect on authentication or on issued certificates today. The fields are a starting guess at what a reference deployment (lldap) needs, documented so the config format is stable ahead of the lookup landing.

## `ldap.enabled`

`bool`, default `false`

Turns on the LDAP lookup once the server consumes it.

## `ldap.url`

`string`, default `empty`

The directory server to connect to.

## `ldap.bind_dn`

`string`, default `empty`

The DN to bind as for the search.

## `ldap.bind_password`

`string`, default `empty`

The password for `bind_dn`.

## `ldap.base_dn`

`string`, default `empty`

The search base for the user lookup.

## `ldap.user_filter`

`string`, default `empty`

The search filter, keyed by the username resolved from OIDC.

## `ldap.logging`

An independent log destination for LDAP activity, routed by a "type=ldap" attribute. The routing is wired up regardless of whether LDAP enrichment itself is consumed.

## `ldap.logging.*`

Log-file rotation for this destination, via the embedded timberjack logger, with the same keys and meanings as logging.* above. This destination is only split out of the main log once its filename is set; until then its records go to the general log.

## `ldap.logging.level`

`string`, default `empty`

The minimum log level for this destination, in the same form as logging.level.

## `ldap.logging.add_source`

`bool`, default `false`

Includes the source file and line on each record.

## `ldap.logging.log_json`

`bool`, default `false`

Writes JSON instead of text. Text is meant to be read, not parsed: the message is written as bare prose so quoted values in it are not escaped, which is not a machine-readable format. Set this wherever a log collector has to pull fields back out.
